beats.say: This map has lied to you your whole life.
beats.title: THIS MAP HAS LIED TO YOU

beats.say: On most world maps, Greenland looks about as big as Africa.
In reality, Africa is fourteen times bigger.
Drag Greenland down to the equator, and watch it shrink to its true size.
Africa covers thirty point four million square kilometers. Greenland, just two point two.
You could fit the United States, China and India inside Africa, and still have room left over.
Blame Gerardus Mercator. His map from 1569 was made for sailors, and it stretches everything near the poles.
Follow for more maps that lie to you.
beats.title: FOLLOW FOR MORE MAP LIES
